origin.description: Evaluate the two sides of a trellis formula and the conditioning factors.
origin.details: A bar separates conditioning variables. Stars and pluses between those variables make further factors. A numeric conditioner is turned into a factor whose levels are sorted.
origin.value: The left-hand values and the 1-based conditioning codes.
origin.example:
form <- latticeParseFormula(mpg ~ wt | cyl, data = mtcars)
cat(as.numeric(form$condition[[1]])[1:6], "\n")
